systems.system: Digitisation of civil registration records (EC-MADA programme)
systems.platform: Studia Inc OCR and AI-driven indexing; autonomous mobile units with satellite connectivity and solar power
systems.owner: Studia Inc (contractor) with D.IA Advisory, under the national EC-MADA programme
systems.tiers: civil registration records of 1,695 communes in 11 priority regions; nearly 10 million records

note: A contractor's digitisation of commune civil registers; the satellite connectivity is on the contractor's mobile units, and no commune office is said to be connected.
